name: Encouragment
overview: Scripture reveals that encouragement comes from God's nearness to the brokenhearted and His promise to save those with contrite spirits, offering comfort and strength in times of weakness (Psalms 34:18). Believers who patiently wait on the Lord will experience renewed strength and endurance, enabling them to persevere without fainting (Isaiah 40:31). God’s plans for His people are rooted in peace and hope, assuring them of a future filled with expectation and purpose (Jeremiah 29:11). Jesus invites all who are burdened to find rest in Him, highlighting the personal and sustaining encouragement available through faith (Matthew 11:28). These truths affirm that with God on our side, no opposition can ultimately prevail against us (Romans 8:31).
